name: generative-virtual-runtime

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/schema/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/canvas-renderer/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/runtime/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/compiler/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/motionscript-emitter/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/format-import-core/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/format-lottie/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/round-trip/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/format-svg/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p evaluation/bench/tsconfig.json
scripts.verify: npm test && npm run typecheck && npm run build --workspace @gvr/playground && npm run validate-ir -- --manifest fixtures/ir/manifest.json && python3 -m unittest discover -s tools/gvr-ops/tests -v && python3 tools/gvr-ops/current_capabilities.py --check

description: GVR is a virtual runtime environment for live, on-the-fly generated software.
